propositions: A stale clone attempting to union after strip silently re-unions stripped history because the first 1,029 commits are byte-identical and merge-base succeeds, bypassing unrelated-histories detection.
The push.py non-fast-forward retry loop at lines 216 and 242 runs an independent git merge and re-push outside sync.py control, allowing stale review-bot writes to circumvent a sync-only guard.
A guard placed before the merge-base test at sync.py:143 blocks the fast-forward adoption convergence path, permanently wedging merely-behind clones.
The epoch field must be added to .store-compat.json and checked via git show <remote_ref>:.store-compat.json to validate both local worktree and remote branch state before any merge.
Both guard sites (sync._union_merge and push_tickets_branch non-FF retry) must refuse and log without merging, with push.py returning immediately to abort the retry loop rather than breaking.
